entries.note: Cat_Twit1, rated 5.0: a happy twit. The source is quiet (peak -17 dBFS); the build lifts it.
Happy Purr/Twitter2, the same cat as the greeting: a warm purr-twit.
Sadiquecat's impatient meow, the first 0.7 s, down two semitones to make it grumbly.
MBPL trill 1 with the 5 Hz, +-1 semitone wobble.
Cat Purr/Twit4, rated 4.9, the shortest clip of this cat (0.37 s): a quick mrp.
catwhirr, a happy whirr at food: the closest this cat has to a pleased, done sound.
Sadiquecat's meow, the falling second half, with a further falling pitch ramp (0 to -4 semitones).
Cat Purr/Twit5 falls on its own, so a rising pitch ramp (-1 to +4 semitones) makes it ask.
Cat Purr/Twit6, rated 5.0: a short, chesty twit.
Cat Meow2: one small meow, the same cat as the greeting.
Pearl's snore: one burst at 1.55 to 1.95 s, with its breath before and after.
MBPL trill 3, down three semitones: a soft 'hm'.
Sadiquecat's impatient meow, the first 0.6 s, then the tail thump.
